Modbus.Title: Gorse - Mitsubishi Ecodan Monitor v0.1
Modbus.Comment: Gorse Labs template v0.1 BETA (AI-assisted, untested). Based on 'Mitsubishi Heat Pump EN v1 (LifeLogic)' by Jonathan Dixon and Lifestyle Logic Limited, https://gitlab.com/joth/loxonetemplates, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes by Gorse Labs: read-only split, signed temperature registers, outdoor/room temps, defrost, compressor, fault code and kWh totals added, 0.1 °C display, plain-English hints, slower polling for setpoints. Register map checked against Mitsubishi Electric UK 'MelcoBEMS MINI (A1M+) ATW Modbus Register Tables' v1.0.1.
Modbus.HintText: Read only, nothing is written to the heat pump. Modbus RTU via MelcoBEMS MINI (A1M/A1M+), 9600 baud, 8N1. Pair with 'Gorse Ecodan Control' only if you need control.
